newsitem.title: USA: Walden Residential offers four mln units.
newsitem.headline: Walden Residential offers four mln units.

text.p: Walden Residential Properties Inc said on Tuesday it offered four million units, consisting of four million shares of 9.20 percent senior preferred stock and four million common stock warrants that expired in five years.
The units were sold under the company's shelf registration statement at a price of $25 per unit, it said.

Walden said it would use net proceeds of $95.3 million to repay outstanding debt of $71.3 million under its credit facility, with the remaining balance available to finance future property acquisitions and working capital purchases.
Each common stock warrant was exercisable for one-third of a share of Walden common stock at an exercise price of $26.875 per share, the company said.
The company said it could not call the senior preferred stock for 10 years.
